verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents side-by-side batch comparisons showing how a workflow edit changed outcomes across hundreds of scenarios. That is a form of reviewing automation changes before deploying them, and workflows can be built, edited and deployed in natural language. Nothing in the evidence describes version history or rollback of workflows. missing for 10: workflow version history, rollback to a prior version, diff/approval review of workflow definitions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Side-by-side batch comparisons show how a workflow edit changed outcomes across hundreds of scenarios, with per-conversation drill-downs when you need to understand a single result.
Build, edit, and deploy workflows using natural language
so every workflow change is tested against the conversations your customers actually have
